svg.title: Room survey: sampled surfaces
svg.desc: Schematic room survey: sampled surfaces in the same red/green-walled indoor room. Synthetic diagram; no LiDAR scan. The left plan locates the example; the right drawing explains its representation.

g.text: Synthetic diagram; no LiDAR scan · original explanatory SVG
A synthetic point sampling of the same room, not a measured scan
Point footprint determines coverage; connectivity is absent
